name: SAP Concur Expense Report Structure
description: Structural documentation for the SAP Concur Expense Report object showing field groupings, data types, and relationships.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User-provided name for the expense report

fields.name: Total
fields.description: Sum of all entry amounts in report currency

fields.name: ApprovalStatusCode
fields.description: Workflow status code. A_FILE=Draft, A_PEND=Pending Manager Approval, A_APPR=Approved, A_EXTV=External Validation

fields.name: PaymentStatusCode
fields.description: Payment status. P_NOTP=Not Processed, P_PROC=Processing, P_PAID=Paid, P_HOLD=On Hold

fields.name: SubmitDate
fields.description: When the report was submitted for approval

fields.name: CreateDate
fields.description: When the report was initially created

fields.name: OwnerLoginID
fields.description: Employee login (email) who owns the report

fields.name: OwnerName
fields.description: Full name of the report owner

fields.name: PolicyID
fields.description: Expense policy applied to the report

fields.name: HasException
fields.description: True if any entry violates policy and has an exception

fields.name: PurposeStatement
fields.description: Business justification for all expenses in the report
fields.example: Expenses incurred attending the annual North America Sales Summit in Chicago.

relationships.description: One report contains many expense entries
The policy governs expense type rules and approval workflows
